mapper.insert: INSERT INTO study_remind (user_id, title, content, remind_time, remind_type, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{remindTime}, #{remindType}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM study_remind WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status != 2 ORDER BY remind_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE study_remind SET status = #{status} WHERE remind_id = #{remindId}
